definitions.explanation: The social stratum between upper and lower class. Japan has historically had a strong middle-class identity.

definitions.gloss: midstream, middle reaches of a river
definitions.explanation: The middle section of a river, between the upper and lower reaches.

examples.japanese: {中流|ちゅうりゅう}{家庭|かてい}で{育|そだ}った。
examples.english: I grew up in a middle-class household.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}では{多|おお}くの{人|ひと}が{自分|じぶん}を{中流|ちゅうりゅう}だと{思|おも}っている。
examples.english: In Japan, many people consider themselves middle class.

examples.japanese: {中流|ちゅうりゅう}{意識|いしき}が{薄|うす}れ、{格差|かくさ}が{広|ひろ}がっている。
examples.english: Middle-class consciousness is fading and inequality is widening.

examples.japanese: {川|かわ}の{中流|ちゅうりゅう}で{釣|つ}りをした。
examples.english: I fished in the middle reaches of the river.

examples.japanese: {中流|ちゅうりゅう}{域|いき}は{流|なが}れが{穏|おだ}やかだ。
examples.english: The midstream area has a gentle current.

examples.japanese: {上流|じょうりゅう}から{中流|ちゅうりゅう}にかけて、{川幅|かわはば}が{徐々|じょじょ}に{広|ひろ}がる。
examples.english: From the upper to the middle reaches, the river gradually widens.

notes:
CULTURE:
The phrase {一億|いちおく}{総|そう}{中流|ちゅうりゅう} (100 million people, all middle class) described Japan's post-war sense of economic equality. This {中流|ちゅうりゅう}{意識|いしき} (middle-class consciousness) has weakened since the 1990s.

WORD FORMATION:
{中|ちゅう} (middle) + {流|りゅう} (stream, class)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中流|ちゅうりゅう}{家庭|かてい}: middle-class household
- {中流|ちゅうりゅう}{意識|いしき}: middle-class consciousness
- {中流|ちゅうりゅう}{階級|かいきゅう}: middle class
